items.title: Jadarian Price: Return to practice on tap in Week 8
items.description:
Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Price (chest) will be designated for return from injured reserve during Week 8, Gregg Bell of Sports Radio 93.3 KJR Seattle reports.

items.title: Aaron Jones: Avoids significant knee injury
items.description:
The left knee injury that forced Jones out of Sunday's 16-10 win over the Colts isn't considered significant, and the running back is viewed as day-to-day, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

items.title: Cam Skattebo: Expected to be OK after hamstring tweak
items.description:
Skattebo is expected to "OK" after tweaking his hamstring on a 42-yard run in overtime during Sunday's 27-21 win over the Texans, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

items.title: Saquon Barkley: 'Trending toward playing' Monday
items.description:
Barkley (hamstring), who is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Cowboys, is "trending toward playing," Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

items.title: Xavier Worthy: Held to 11 yards on six targets
items.description:
